prompts.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create a seamless SIX-frame WALK-IN-PLACE animation sprite sheet of Elowen for her side-scrolling game. Reference1 is exact character identity; reference2 is her existing blocking sprite for consistent pixel style. Preserve golden blonde hair, pointed elf ears, blue eyes and blue jewels, silver armour with gold trim, navy blue gold embroidered cloak/tabard, sword and navy/gold kite shield. All six poses face SCREEN RIGHT, never turn or flip. 1536x1024 canvas, exact3 columns x2rows,512x512 cells read left-to-right then top-to-bottom. Feet ground baseline y460 in each cell, pelvis x256 fixed, body about340px tall. Entire sword shield hair cloak fit each cell with50px transparent margins. Detailed crisp pixel art matching supplied game character. Six DISTINCT walking gait phases contact/down/passing/opposite contact/down/passing, alternating near and far feet. Both feet never leave ground together: WALK, not run. Full loop returns naturally to first frame. Genuine fully transparent alpha background, no gradient, vignette, glow, shadow, text or grid lines. Exactly2arms2legs. Natural relaxed upright walking: clear alternating leg strides, relaxed counter-swing of arms carrying sword lowered safely and shield at her side, responsive gentle torso twist, subtle head bob, long hair and cloak/tabard sway with delayed follow-through. Not rigid statues, not an attack; all six poses visibly different.
